preconditions.description: The number of castles n is between 1 and 40, and the total liquid k is between 1 and 1000.
The input consists of exactly n + 1 lines: the first line contains n and k, followed by n lines of adjacency matrix.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == n for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each of the n adjacency lines contains exactly n integers.

preconditions.expression: all(int(line.split()[i]) in {0, 1} for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: Each entry in the adjacency matrix is either 0 or 1.

preconditions.expression: all(int(line.split()[i]) == int(line.split()[j]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for i in range(n) for j in range(n) if i != j and int(line.split()[i]) == 1)
preconditions.description: The adjacency matrix is symmetric (ai,j = aj,i).

preconditions.expression: all(int(line.split()[i]) == 0 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: No castle is connected to itself (ai,i = 0).

postconditions.description: The output is a string representing the maximum possible sum of stabilities of the walls, with an absolute or relative error not exceeding 1e-6.

postconditions.expression: max_sum == sum(x[i] * x[j] for i in range(n) for j in range(i + 1, n) if adjacency[i][j] == 1) for some x in [x1, x2, ..., xn] where sum(x) == k and x[i] >= 0 for all i
postconditions.description: The output is the maximum sum of stabilities (x[i] * x[j]) for all walls (i, j) where adjacency[i][j] == 1, given the total liquid k is distributed among castles.
